family: Explanatory editorial diagram — primary lane of ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1 (~70% of article-body visual use).
primary_job: Make a relationship, process, or authority boundary easier to inspect than prose (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §1 'explain', §2.2).

semantic_density.rationale: One claim or mechanism per image, held to a compact set of groups — richer than a thumbnail's single tension but narrower than a body infographic's multi-module synthesis (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1).

visual_density.rationale: Grid-led composition, sparse connectors, clear first-read hierarchy, low decorative density (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.1).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: Deterministic short relationship/boundary labels only; mutable copy (titles, dates, captions, citations) stays outside the artwork (ARTICLE-VISUAL-PUBLICATION-HANDOFF.md §1).

composition.dominant_structure: One relationship, process, or authority boundary, grid-led, with sparse connectors that clarify hierarchy rather than build a dense network (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.2; DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §2 line behavior).
composition.reading_path: Single inspection path along the relationship or process.

audience_adaptation.domain-expert: Legend optional; technical relationship vocabulary allowed without expansion.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: Decompose the relationship into fewer, explicitly labeled steps; expand every acronym on first use.
audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Use concrete, literal depictions of the relationship rather than schematic abstraction; the legend cannot be load-bearing (audience/child-upper-elementary.json modality_effects.visual).

renderer_preference.rule: Topology and relationship arrows that carry a factual boundary must stay deterministic and traceable; generative rendering is reserved for illustrative connective tissue and must never invent topology (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.2, §12 renderer integrity).

requirements: line weight/contrast that survives mobile rendering
no reliance on hover or desktop-only interaction

readability_gate.rationale: A body-placed explanatory diagram is a body-facing visual and inherits the SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5 mobile gate.

split_rule.rule: If the diagram begins carrying more than one relationship/process/boundary, split it into separate diagrams rather than compressing labels (generalization of SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6 to the single-relationship case).

acceptance: the reviewer can state which relationship, process, or boundary the diagram makes inspectable
one dominant relation, not an assembled set of unrelated nodes
passes VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md — the diagram is not a redraw of an immediately preceding sequence or pairing
reject: generic network-node wallpaper with no thesis (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §12)
ornamental nodes that add no relation
paragraph-to-icons transcription with one label per noun and no new relation (VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md §10 R3)
